newsitem.title: CHINA: Turner expands TV distribution deal with Austar.
newsitem.headline: Turner expands TV distribution deal with Austar.

text.p: Turner International said on Monday it had reached an agreement with pay television provider Austar to expand distribution of the TNT & Cartoon Network in Australia.

The agreement will be effective from August 1 and provide the programming to another 150,000 subscribers, Turner International, the distribution arm of Time Warner Inc subsidiary Turner Broadcasting System Inc, said in a statement.
"This agreement increases TNT & Cartoon Network's reach in Australia to over 600,000 subscribers in total," Turner International said.
Austar, a unit of Denver-based United International Holdings Inc, holds a franchise for the delivery of satellite television in regional Australia.
